items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: He called me up, man, we've got to put some tunes together. Right. So we basically went into the studio and, and, and, and, and put songs together in the studio.

ctx.x: What year is this? Like, oh man. 1958, I think. Maybe so. Maybe so. But it was a record he was doing for RCA.

Yeah. Okay. And so what happened, he said he wanted to do a session on me, Ray. He called me up, man, we've got to put some tunes together. Right. So we basically went into the studio and, and, and, and, and put songs together in the studio.
